sources.searcher_note: Lists the NRCC report the lead calls the Sept 2024 monthly, labeled OCT MONTHLY: filed Oct 20 2024, end date Sept 30 2024, receipts $18,848,596.96, spending $40,724,721.90, cash $48,875,271.80. Does not say FEC totals omit it.

FEC's own 2023-24 totals for the NRCC (coverage 01/01/2023-12/31/2024): receipts $236,307,296.49, disbursements $219,752,099.68, ending cash $11,084,115.74. The page has no note about a missing report.

sources.outlet: Federal Election Commission, bulk data documentation
sources.quote: These totals also incorporate any changes made by committees if any report covering the period is amended.
sources.searcher_note: FEC's description of how summary totals handle amended reports; background on the mechanism, not about NRCC.

sources.quote: The NRCC has $70.75 million on hand, $16 million less than the DCCC.
sources.searcher_note: Covers the NRCC's August 2024 report (the one before the report in question): raised $9.7M, $70.75M cash. Not about FEC totals.

notes: No source found that reports FEC totals leaving out the NRCC's report for Sept 2024, or any FEC roll-up error for this committee. ProPublica Itemizer confirms the report exists with the lead's figures; the FEC labels it OCT MONTHLY (coverage through Sept 30 2024). The Itemizer's SEP MONTHLY row (end date Aug 31 2024) shows a filed date of Nov 7 2024, which may be an amendment. The Itemizer page header shows 2024 totals of $163,825,376 receipts and $195,276,343 spending through Dec 31 2024, apparently calendar 2024 only. No news coverage found of the NRCC's September 2024 monthly figures themselves. A Boston University piece on an old FEC computer error (Collins-Allen race) returned an image instead of text, and a POGO report on FEC data not adding up (2001) returned 403. Neither is recorded.
